name: Vacoflux50
variant: 0.35 mm strip, magnetic final anneal (820 C, 4 h, hydrogen)

provenance.source: VAC 'Soft magnetic cobalt-iron alloys VACOFLUX and VACODUR' (edition 2021), docs/sources/materials/vac_cobalt_iron_alloys_vacoflux_vacodur_2021.pdf, p. 8: DC table for 0.35 mm strip after magnetic final annealing, 300-16000 A/m. Grade C: no data below 300 A/m (the brochure plots no VACOFLUX 50 curve), so the curve below 300 A/m is the B-H pipeline's interpolation from the origin.
provenance.anneal_recipe: 820 C, 4 h, hydrogen, cooling 100-200 K/h (VAC brochure p. 15)

stacking_factor_source: PROVISIONAL: the VAC brochure gives no stacking factor; 0.95 is a placeholder until the supplier states one
saturation_polarisation_source: VAC brochure p. 5/8: VACOFLUX 48/50 Js 2.30 T
